DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、聞いて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: どう考えてもひどくない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: どうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生もスタディーエリアの広さは知ってるでしょ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あそこの落ち葉を一人で掃除しろって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: セミナーに言われたの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いくら、私たちを目の敵にしてるからってひどいと思わない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: たしかに一人だと大変だね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: いきなり掃除をするよう言われたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 実は……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ミレニアムのモノレールにグラフィティを描いたら

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと怒られて……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もしかして、それのせいかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そうだと思うよ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今週末の予定って決まってる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 特に予定はないけど、何かあったの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: えっとね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 近くの山に登ろうと思ったんだけど、一人だと寂しくて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 良かったら、一緒に来てくれない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: マキが……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……登山を！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なに、その反応は……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 前にも山で会ったことあるのに

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ごめんごめん、でも……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 電子機器とかグラフィティが関係ないのに

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: マキから誘ってくれるなんて珍しいような

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うーん

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それはそうかも……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: とにかく、オッケーってことで良いでしょ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、また週末ね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今週末も時間ある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: D.U.近くで有名なキャンプ場があるらしいんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 良かったら一緒に行かない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……そのキャンプ場で、限定モンスターが出るとか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: え、どうして分かったの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もしかして、先生もARムシクイーンやってるの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: マキがキャンプの話をするとしたら……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ゲームに関することかなって思ったんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あっ、ひどい！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……まあ、そうなんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それで、今週末は空いてる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 一人だと危ないかもしれないし……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私も同行するね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ありがとう、先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今年もそろそろ終わっちゃうね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: やりたいことがいっぱいあったはずなのに

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あっという間の一年だったよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 本当にね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今年中に終わらせなくちゃいけない仕事が……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そういえば、セミナーも忙しそうにしてたような

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、あたしにも何か手伝わせてよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、次の当番で領収書の整理をお願いしようかな

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 領収書の整理がまったく進んでないんだよね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 分かった、やってみるね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……あれ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その締切、今日までじゃなかった？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 次の当番じゃ間に合わないような……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: これ、ユウカ先輩は知ってるの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 内緒にしてくれないかな……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 妖怪MAXの限定トロピカル味が飲みたくなってきたなぁ～

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……当番の日までに用意しておくね

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님도 밀레니엄에 자주 오니 우리 학습관이 얼마나 넓은지는 알고 있잖아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그런데 세미나에서 그 넓은 학습관에 떨어진 낙엽들을

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아무리 베리타스가 세미나에 미운털이 자주 박혔다고는 하지만, 이건 너무한 거 아니야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 확실히 마키 혼자 하기에는 어려운 일이긴 한데…

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 갑자기 아무런 전조도 없이 낙엽 청소를 시킨 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 학원 모노레일에 그린 그래피티 때문에 살짝 잔소리를 듣긴 했는데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 이번 주 주말에 시간 괜찮아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 근처의 산에 등산을 가려 했는데 혼자는 조금 심심해서

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 괜찮다면 가볍게 같이 다녀오지 않을래?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 전에도 종종 휴일에 밖에서 만난 적은 있었잖아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 마키가 밖에 나가자고 한 건 처음인 것 같아서

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다른 게 아니라 D.U.에서 멀지 않은 곳에 유명한 캠핑장이 있다고 하는데

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: …그 캠핑장에서 게임과 관련된 아이템을 받을 수 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 선생님도 무시퀸 AR 시작한 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 이번 주말에 시간 내 줄 수 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 초보자에게 솔로 캠핑은 위험할 수 있으니까…

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러고 보니 올해도 거의 다 끝났네

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭔가 하고 싶었던 게 잔뜩 있었던 것 같은데

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 올해의 일이 아직 잔뜩 남아 있는데…

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러고 보니 세미나도 올해의 업무를 정리하느라 정신이 없어 보이던데

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 샬레는 어때? 혹시 도와줄 거 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 다음 당번 때 영수증 정리를 도와줄 수 있을까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 연말 정산에 필요한 영수증 정리가 아직이라.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러고 보니 샬레의 영수증 정리 마감일은 오늘까지 아니었어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 유우카 선배는 그 사실 알고 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어쩐지 요괴 MAX 한정 트로피컬 맛이 먹고 싶은 기분인데~

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Listen to me, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No matter how I look at it, this is too much!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's going on, Maki?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You've been to Millennium a lot, Sensei! You've seen how big our study center is!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Seminar's making me sweep up all the fallen leaves

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: in that giant study center, all by myself!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I get that Seminar isn't Veritas' biggest fan, but isn't that way over the top?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: They're making you do such a difficult task by yourself, Maki?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: They told you to do this for no reason?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Um...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Weeell, before Seminar assigned me here...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...I did get in a tiny bit of trouble for graffiting the school's monorails.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I doubt that's the reason though.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I think that's exactly the reason...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you free this weekend by any chance?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I don't have anything special going on... Why?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Um, weeell

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I wanted to go hiking on this nearby mountain, but it'd be way too boring by myself.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do you think you'd be down to come with me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Maki...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: ...and hiking?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What's with that reaction?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: We've met up outdoors before, haven't we?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sorry, sorry. It's just that...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It feels like this is your first time asking me to go outside.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You only ever want to go graffiti or get electronics.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Fine, I guess that's true, but still...!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyways, you have time, right?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll see you this weekend, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you free this weekend too?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I heard of a really popular campground not far from the D.U.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So would you like to go camping together?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: ...Is there a game-related item that you can acquire at said campground?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah. How'd you know?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you playing Mushiqueen AR too, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: No, I just figured that if you're bringing up camping...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: ...it's probably game-related.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's so mean of you to stereotype me like that!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...You're not wrong, though.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyways, can you make time for me this weekend?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Solo camping is really dangerous for beginners, after all...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll join you, only for safety reasons.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Now that I think about it, this year's almost over.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It still feels like there were lots of things I wanted to do.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Time just flies by!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I agree...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: There's still so much work left to do this year...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Now that I think about it, Seminar was super-busy taking care of year-end stuff.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: How about Schale? Is there anything I can help with?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Can you help me sort receipts during your next Student Rep shift?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: There are still receipts to sort for year-end settlement.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay. I'll help you the next time I'm the Student Rep.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Huh?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thinking about it, isn't Schale's expense deadline today?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But if you wait for the next time I'm on duty...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Does Yuuka know about this?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Can you keep it a secret?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Fufu.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: For some reason, I'm in a mood for limited Frenzy MAX Tropical flavor...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: ...I'll have it ready by your next Student Rep shift.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ฉันขอบ่นหน่อยสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ว่าจะคิดยังไง ฉันว่านี่มันก็เกินไปนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มีเรื่องอะไรเหรอ มากิ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครูเองก็มาที่มิลเลเนียมบ่อยๆ
งั้นก็รู้ใช่มั้ยล่ะ ว่าวิทยาเขตของเรา
มันกว้างแค่ไหน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่เซมิน่าน่ะสิ สั่งให้ฉันไปกวาด
ใบไม้ร่วงทั่วโรงเรียน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วก็ให้ไปทำคนเดียวด้วย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงเวอริทัสจะก่อเรื่องให้เซมิน่าปวดหัว
บ่อยๆ แต่แบบนี้มันเกินไปแล้วหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ให้มากิไปทำคนเดียวมันก็ลำบาก
อยู่นะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
โดนให้ไปกวาดใบไม้ร่วงโดยไม่
แจ้งล่วงหน้าเลยเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ที่จริงก่อนที่เซมิน่าจะเรียกฉันไปเฉ่ง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันมีคดีเรื่องกราฟิตี้ที่ไปวาดไว้บน
รถไฟฟ้านิดหน่อยน่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หรือว่าจะเป็นเพราะเรื่องนั้นนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: น่าจะเป็นเพราะเรื่องนั้นนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สุดสัปดาห์นี้พอมีเวลาว่างมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ ครูยังไม่มีนัดอะไร... ทำไมเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม... คือว่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันจะไปปีนเขาแถวๆ นี้น่ะ แต่ไป
คนเดียวก็น่าเบื่อไปหน่อย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าครูไม่ติดอะไร เราไปปีนเขาชิลๆ
กันมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มากิ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จะปีนเขาเนี่ยนะ...?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมมีปฏิกิริยาแบบนั้นล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
วันหยุดก่อนหน้านี้เราก็เคยเจอกัน
ข้างนอกอยู่บ้างไม่ใช่เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ขอโทษๆ ก็แค่...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
นี่เป็นครั้งแรกที่มากิมาชวนไป
ข้างนอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แบบที่ไม่เกี่ยวกับอุปกรณ์
อิเล็คทรอนิกส์หรือกราฟิตี้น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มันก็จริงอยู่หรอกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่เอาเป็นว่าไปได้ใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเจอกันสุดสัปดาห์นี้นะคุณครู!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู~

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สุดสัปดาห์นี้พอมีเวลามั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันได้ยินว่ามีที่ตั้งแคมป์ชื่อดังที่อยู่
ไม่ไกลจาก D.U. มากน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าไม่ติดอะไร เอาไว้เราไปตั้งแคมป์
ด้วยกันมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ไปตั้งแคมป์ที่นั่นแล้วจะได้ไอเทม
ในเกมเหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ๊ะ รู้ได้ยังไงน่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หรือว่าคุณครูก็เริ่มเล่นมูชิควีน AR
แล้วเหมือนกัน?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เปล่าหรอก แค่เห็นจู่ๆ มากิมาชวน
ไปแคมป์ปิ้งน่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูก็เลยคิดว่าต้องเกี่ยวกับเกมแน่ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คิดว่าฉันเป็นคนแบบนั้นเหรอ
เกินไปแล้วนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถึงที่พูดมามันจะจริงก็เถอะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งั้นสุดสัปดาห์นี้พอมีเวลาให้ฉันหน่อย
มั้ยล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ให้มือใหม่ไปตั้งแคมป์คนเดียว
มันอาจจะอันตรายก็ได้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูจะไปด้วยเพื่อความปลอดภัย
แล้วกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณนะ คุณครู!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: จะว่าไป นี่ก็เกือบหมดไปอีกปีแล้วแฮะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันมีนู่นนี่ที่อยากทำตั้งมากมาย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่เวลามันผ่านไปเร็วจริงๆ เลย~

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูเห็นด้วย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: งานของปีนี้ก็ยังมีค้างอยู่เพียบเลยด้วย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
จะว่าไป เซมิน่าก็เหมือนจะยุ่งกับ
การเคลียร์งานของปีนี้อยู่นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ที่ชาเล่ต์ล่ะเป็นไงบ้าง? มีอะไรให้
ฉันช่วยมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ตอนมาเข้าเวรครั้งหน้า ช่วยจัดการ
ใบเสร็จให้หน่อยได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูยังไม่ได้เคลียร์ใบเสร็จเอาไว้
ทำบัญชีเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ได้เลย ไว้ครั้งหน้าฉันจะเข้าไปช่วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เอ๋?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ใบเสร็จของชาเล่ต์ต้องเคลียร์ให้
เสร็จภายในวันนี้ไม่ใช่เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แล้วถ้าทำตอนเข้าเวรครั้งหน้า
จะไปทันได้ไง...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: รุ่นพี่ยูกะรู้เรื่องนี้หรือเปล่าน่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ช่วยเก็บเป็นความลับให้หน่อยได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
รู้สึกอยากกินมอนสเตอร์แม็กซ์
รสทรอปิคอลจังเลยน้า~

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูจะซื้อเตรียมไว้ให้นะ...

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，你聽我說

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這實在是，不管怎麼想都太過分了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 發生什麼事了嗎，真紀？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師常來千年，應該知道我們的研究區域有多大吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 可是研討會卻要我一個人在這麼大的研究區域

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 把落葉全部清掉！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然我也聽說過貝里塔斯不受研討會的歡迎，但這也太過分了吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 要真紀一個人做，確實是有點強人所難……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 怎麼會突然要你去清理落葉呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 唔嗯

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 其實在被叫去研討會之前

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我因為在學園的單軌列車上塗鴉，所以被念了一下……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 應該跟這件事沒關係吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 八成就是因為這件事吧……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 你這週末有空嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，沒有特別的安排……怎麼了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 就是啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我想去附近爬山，但一個人去有點無聊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以如果你沒事的話，要不要一起去？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 真紀居然……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……要去爬山！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這是什麼反應

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之前假日的時候，我們不也常常在外面碰到嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 抱歉抱歉。只是……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這好像還是真紀第一次約我出去

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 而且還是因為電子設備和塗鴉無關的事

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: QAQ

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 確實是那樣沒錯

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 總之你有時間對吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那就週末見囉，老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師～

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這個週末你也有空嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我聽說在離D.U.不遠的地方有個知名的露營區

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果可以的話，要不要一起去露營？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……在那個露營區能獲得遊戲相關的道具嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 咦，你怎麼會知道？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 難道老師也開始玩甲蟲皇后AR了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒有，只是真紀居然突然會邀請我去露營……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 感覺十之八九跟遊戲有關

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 怎麼對我有這種偏見呢，好過分！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……不過其實也沒說錯啦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以這個週末能麻煩你空出時間嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 因為單人露營對初學者可能有點危險……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 為了安全起見，我也跟你一起去吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 謝謝你，老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 話說今年也快結束了呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 明明還有很多事情想做的說

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 時間也過得太快了吧～

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我也有同感……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 今年還有好多事沒完成……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這麼說來，研討會好像也正忙著整理今年的工作

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 夏萊那邊還好嗎？需不需要幫忙？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 那下次當值日生的時候，可以幫我整理收據嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 年底要結算的收據，我到現在都還沒整理完

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 知道了，下次我去會幫忙的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 話說，夏萊的收據結算截止日期不是今天嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 你怎麼說下次當值日生的時候再整理……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這件事情，優香前輩他知道嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 能幫我保密嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不知道為什麼，突然好想喝妖怪MAX的限定熱帶口味哦～

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……下次當值日生之前，我會幫你準備好的
